exemptions: This repository is a CLI/library; endpoint, database, MCP, and UI product surfaces are out of scope for this fix.

contract.intent: Make Codex-backed GitHub PR reviews bounded and usable by preventing duplicate failures, allowing realistic Codex deadlines, and enforcing source budgets fail-closed.

outcomes.statement: Codex output-schema rejection still retries without schema.
Authentication and process failures do not trigger a duplicate Codex invocation.
Codex uses a five-minute default worker deadline while explicit timeout overrides remain bounded.
GitHub PR file and byte budgets are enforced by marking omitted files UNREVIEWED.
The package typechecks, tests, documentation gates, and packs successfully.

tracking.reason: Local library fix; no external issue or PR transition is authorized by this task.
